The reference curve is a stored column; no new SE, fit, bootstrap, or required-n calculation.
Saved 2,000 resamples per n; the cumulative curve is one nested saved sequence.
Mean-cost estimator, not the aggregate cost of n runs or server CPU time. Full prefix + tail + Hadamard wrapper.
Unobserved rare-event costs remain unknown. State preparation and FTQC are excluded; no population guarantee.
